method: Pairs and groups reproduced with release_comparison's own definitions (base and candidate links joined on link_key; one-to-one pairs for value groups). Each row is then attributed by its mechanism in the candidate's own evidence (source_members, valid_rendition_members, fingerprints) or by the naming rule that produces the candidate filename from the raw capture (final_url, trailing slash, context, member path), not by count. Per-row tables are pinned below.

owner_questions.question: The final-URL name replaces the requested-URL name, and filename readings read only the effective name, so tokens only the requested URL had are dropped: 320 documents lose a filename date, 525 lose a kind, 2 lose committee keys.
owner_questions.recommendation: Filename readings fall back to the requested URL's name for date, kind and committee where the effective name gives none (D3 semantics; moves catalog_version, so D3 and D4 re-run).
